cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?
